summary.zh: 典籍厅是清代内阁存贮清宫奏册、表文的机构。故宫博物院词解还记载“典籍厅有库”；厅的独立建筑边界及存续现状尚未核实。
summary.en: Dianji Hall was an office of the Qing Grand Secretariat for storing palace memorial registers and formal addresses. The Palace Museum glossary also records an associated storehouse; the hall’s independent building boundaries and survival have not been verified.

functionTag.en: Storing memorial registers and formal addresses

evidenceNote.zh: 方位证据尚有参照冲突：官网正文将典籍厅列在堂后斋宿所东侧，《清宫述闻》卷二，十三叶背面（13b，本章影像第26/132张，非印刷第26页）却写“又西爲典籍廳”，未重述“西”的参照点。本条不选择落位，也不以未经证实的搬迁解释差异。“厅有库”不等于厅就是典籍库；典籍厅亦不等于满票签档子房。不据邻屋推定形制。
evidenceNote.en: The location references remain unresolved: the official article places Dianji Hall east of the lodging area behind the main hall, while Qinggong Shuwen, volume two, leaf 13 verso (13b, chapter image 26/132, not printed page 26), says “Dianji Hall was to the west” without restating the reference point for west. This entry chooses no location and does not invent a relocation to reconcile the accounts. An associated storehouse does not make the hall identical to the Dianji storehouses, nor is it the Manchu Archives Room. No form is inferred from neighboring buildings.

modelNote.zh: 本条仅提供历史信息，未绑定独立模型或地图位置，不提供直达。
modelNote.en: This is an information-only entry. No independent model or map position is bound, and direct travel is unavailable.

siteAccess.zh: 现场开放与入内安排尚未核实。
siteAccess.en: Current visitor access and entry arrangements have not been verified.

sources.title: 内阁大堂
sources.shortPrimaryQuote: 堂后为内阁大学士斋宿之所，其东为满票签档子房、典籍厅。
sources.glossaryQuote: 清代内阁专司清宫存贮奏册、表文之处。
sources.limitation: The glossary records the storage function and an associated storehouse, not identity with the Dianji storehouses. The body’s east reference differs from the original-image west wording; neither establishes a unique location, boundary, surviving form or visitor access.

limitations: Stored official HTML and retained original image reviewed locally; no fresh online retrieval.
Official east and original-image west references remain unresolved; no chosen location or invented relocation.
An associated storehouse does not establish identity with the Dianji storehouses or Manchu Archives Room.
No inferred building shell, orientation, measurements, materials, coordinates, survival or visitor access.
Historical information only; no independent model, map position or travel target.

originalImageReview.shortPrimaryQuote: 堂之後爲中堂齋宿之所又東爲滿票簽檔子房又西爲典籍廳
originalImageReview.limitation: Original image: leaf 13 verso (13b), chapter image 26/132, not printed page 26. The west reference is legible but its reference point is not restated. It cannot resolve the official east reference or establish geometry or relocation.
